description.value: Spokes Bicycle Rentals is Vancouver's longest-running bike rental company, founded in 1938 and family-owned, situated steps from the entrance to Stanley Park and the Seawall. They operate the largest rental fleet in Vancouver, spanning cruisers, hybrids, mountain bikes, e-bikes, e-scooters, tandems, and a full range of family and child options. A second Waterfront location at 870 Cordova St. West serves cyclists at the Convention Center end of the Seawall.

The OSM name 'Spokes Cycle Rental' does not match the website's consistent branding of 'Spokes Bicycle Rentals', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Spokes Cycle Rental' but the website consistently uses 'Spokes Bicycle Rentals' — the OSM record likely has an incorrect name.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, family-owned rental operation at the gateway to Stanley Park with the largest bike fleet in Vancouver; directly serves visiting and touring cyclists and has strong value for the WWC directory.

Bike rentals.detail: Largest rental fleet in Vancouver per website; includes step-thru and step-over cruisers (1spd and 7spd), city hybrids (21spd), mountain bikes, step-thru and step-over e-cruisers (30–65 km range), e-scooters, tandems, junior mountain bikes, child trailers, child seats, trail-a-bikes, and dog baskets. Available at both locations
